headline: North Georgia stand alone as the last unbeaten side
dek: North Georgia are still the only side in the conference without a defeat, six wins and five draws into the season, with 26 goals scored and thirteen conceded. The draws in conference play, though, leave them second to Flagler in the table.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: North Georgia's 26 goals are more than USC Aiken and Lander have scored between them, and twelve different players have shared them.

wire.line: North Georgia are still unbeaten, but a run of draws has let Flagler, beaten once, go top of the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seven matches have passed their date with no published result, the most recent of them Clayton State's visit to Lander in September.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Middle Georgia State have conceded 33 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, while scoring twenty.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored nine of Middle Georgia State's twenty goals from 31 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored eight of North Georgia's 26 goals from 28 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Theo Hoang has scored seven of Georgia Southwestern's ten goals from thirteen shots.

last_match.line: Flagler's win keeps them top of the table; it is Lander's first conference defeat of the season.

next_match.line: Middle Georgia State come in off back-to-back defeats; Flagler have yet to lose in conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
